note: Each planted problem is located by an anchor string, not a line number, so editing the fixture can't silently shift the answers. A finding matches when the file is the same, its line range (+/- 3) overlaps the anchor line (or the anchor plus `span` lines after it, for problems that live in a whole function body), and its category is one of the allowed ones.

planted.what: TOKEN_TTL is never enforced; tokens never expire
user filename interpolated into a shell command
None from verify() is not rejected; anonymous orders
unknown product id crashes with TypeError
test swallows every exception, cannot fail
complex discount logic has no tests

known_real_note: Real problems in the fixture that weren't deliberately planted; the agents found them in the first live run (2026-11-08). They count toward precision (a correct finding isn't noise) but not recall (the agents aren't required to find them). Same matching rules; each is credited to at most one finding, so duplicates still count as noise.

one global SQLite connection shared across threads without locking
any FLASHnn code up to 50% is accepted
